adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts), the decrypted `keys` payload is `JSON.parse(...)`’d and then written directly to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` / `create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })` with no validation against any per-app credential schema and no merge with existing stored fields. This means a partial incoming payload will overwrite the entire stored `credential.key` object and can drop previously stored properties (e.g., refresh_token/expiry fields) rather than preserving them. Additionally, the code uses `findFirst` on `{ userId, appId }` and updates only that one record, which would be incorrect if multiple matching credentials can exist (uniqueness is not shown in the diff).
